resources.string: Camera permission is required to control the flashlight. Screen Light works without camera permission.
Strobe mode flashes the light repeatedly and may bother people sensitive to flashing lights or photosensitive epilepsy. Use with caution and avoid pointing it at anyone unexpectedly.
Camera flash not available. Screen Light is still available.
All lighting effects happen locally on your device, with no internet connection required. This app is entirely open source, and the code is available for inspection on GitHub.

Effective August 1, 2026.

Bright Flashlight is developed by ThinApps.

Bright Flashlight requests Camera permission only to detect and control the device camera flash through Android camera APIs. The app does not take photos, record video or audio, or read camera images. Torch, Strobe, and SOS use the flash hardware only.

Torch, Strobe, and SOS can continue through an Android foreground service while the app is outside the foreground. Android displays a persistent service notification when applicable. The service controls the light and Auto-off timer locally and does not send activity data to ThinApps.

Screen Light changes only the device display color and does not require Camera permission.

The app stores a small set of interface preferences locally using Android DataStore, including the selected mode, Auto-off duration, Strobe speed, supported Torch brightness level, Screen Light color or preset, and color tray state. These preferences are used only to restore user choices. Active Torch, Strobe, or SOS state is not saved as a preference. Preferences are cleared when app data is cleared or the app is uninstalled.

Bright Flashlight has no Internet permission, accounts, advertising, analytics, or cloud service operated by ThinApps. ThinApps does not receive, sell, or share lighting choices or app activity. Android cloud backup is disabled for this app.

For privacy questions, contact ThinApps at support@thinapps.top.
